Butter Revolt.lua – Feature Overview
Auto Farm Features

Auto Click Fruit
Automatically refreshes the tree list, teleports you to available lemon trees, and continuously clicks fruit using the game's click detector.

Auto Upgrade Stands
Upgrades your unlocked income stands automatically, prioritizing the most efficient upgrades based on a cash value calculation.

Auto Buy Buttons
Scans your tycoon for available purchase buttons and buys them automatically, starting with the cheapest and working up to the most expensive.

Auto Click Stands
Automatically activates the income remote for your highest unlocked stand, removing the need for manual clicking.

Auto Collect Bags
Collects dropped money bags as they appear by automatically triggering their touch interactions.

Auto Phone Deals
Detects incoming phone offers, increases the offer value, and accepts it until the deal window closes.

Auto Rebirth
Automatically rebirths when your predicted investor count reaches or exceeds your configured rebirth target.

Auto Evolution
Automatically evolves your tycoon once the required investor thresholds and bonus requirements are met.

Auto Ascend
Triggers ascension automatically when your tycoon's button purchase progress reaches 100%.

Auto Claim Vine
Monitors the sewer cash vine and claims it automatically whenever it becomes available.

Movement & Utility Features

Custom Walkspeed
Lets you set your own walking speed using an adjustable slider.

Fly Mode
Enables a custom flight system with a keybind (default: Q), allowing free movement using standard WASD controls.

Noclip Mode
Disables character collisions with a keybind (default: N), allowing you to move through walls and objects.

Infinite Jump
Allows continuous jumping in midair without needing to touch the ground.

BTools (Building Tools)
Adds Delete and Undo tools to your inventory, letting you remove objects and restore them to their original positions.

Anti-AFK
Prevents idle kicks by simulating player activity whenever your character is inactive.

Quest & Collection Shortcuts

Claim UFO Key
Saves your current position, teleports you to the UFO key, claims it, and then returns you to where you were.

Claim Vine Key
Teleports you to the sewer vine key, unlocks the door, and returns you to your original location.

Performance & Optimization

Disable 3D Rendering
Turns off world rendering to significantly reduce GPU usage while farming in the background.

Disable Game Sound
Mutes the game's audio directly through the client settings.

30 FPS Mode
Limits the game's framerate to 30 FPS to reduce CPU usage and improve efficiency.

60 FPS Mode
Quickly restores the framerate cap back to 60 FPS.

UI & Customization

Rebirth & Evolution Multipliers
Allows you to customize your preferred rebirth and evolution targets using sliders and text boxes.

Watermark HUD
Displays information such as script version, access level, current date, and a live clock.

Custom Color Pickers
Lets you customize the appearance of interface elements, including backgrounds, toggles, highlights, text boxes, and borders.

Preset Themes
Includes several built-in themes such as Default, Dark Green, Dark Blue, Purple Rose, and Skeet.

Config Profile Manager
Allows you to save and load different farming configurations, settings, and profiles.
